title: Oracle restoration with a side condition
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, $f$ a tape content, $p$ an integer, and $side$ and $verdict$ Boolean values. If $p$ lies on the side specified by $side$ (that is, $0\le p$ when $side$ is true and $p\le0$ otherwise), then there is a side value $side'$ with the same property such that, after $|p|+3$ steps from the ready configuration containing the one-letter verdict word in read state, the oracle-dispatch machine is in the local configuration at position $p$, in answer state carrying $verdict$ and $side'$, preserving the input-head position and output.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ lies on the side specified by $side$
